invariants.text: Every scientific Test run binds to one certified EntityClass and one Regime.
RegimeDepth never creates a new EntityClass by itself.
Tests may read only declared capabilities.
TestProtocol V1 is read-only; Tests cannot affect development/selection.
Plateau is observer/Test-Pack-relative and never implies Lift.
Lift requires a separate LiftCertificate with explicit scope and reopen rules.
Execution topology (1 core, N cores, machine) cannot alter the scientific projection.
AI/interpretation can propose but cannot certify or silently mutate exact science.
Theorem/Law transport and novelty scanning are distinct operations.
PrimitiveSemanticsSentinel and RegimeBoundarySentinel answer different questions.
Historical L/O labels remain provenance aliases, not architecture types.
Legacy Scout/OScout outputs remain scientific oracles until generic interfaces reproduce them.
